capsule.rationale: Workflow authority and defect closure are consequential governance; separate Astra design and Sol challenge, one Sol implementation owner and independent review.

scope.S1: Permanent bounded coordinator arbitration instructions, reusable decision record, static guardrails and workflow documentation only.

non_goals: Ledger schema or replay changes; new quotas or phase slots
Issue23/83/84 and PR85 changes or stopped-ticket resumption
Role model/effort/access/registration changes; accepted history rewrites

invariants.I1: Repeated concerns or shifting requirements stop handoffs for one accountable coordinator decision against frozen criteria with recorded scenarios, evidence, disagreements and rationale.
invariants.I2: Demonstrated correctness defects require repair and evidence; no false passed checks, waiver, unanimity requirement or automatic design reset.
invariants.I3: Existing independent consequential design/challenge/approval and review, finite counts and ledger/content gates remain authoritative; same-scope repair stays with approved owner.
invariants.I4: Workflow-only changes preserve role settings, product behavior, prior ledgers and historical records.

interfaces: Coordinator instructions and reusable documentation decision record
Static workflow validation and focused test fixtures
capsule.json_state_impact: none: no product graph/checkpoint JSON or ledger schema/replay changes

acceptance.AC1: Operational repetition/requirement-shift trigger, paused handoffs, evidence consolidation and classification, one accountable decision, one focused closure condition and bounded disposition.
acceptance.AC2: Concrete defect closure, contract ambiguity, preference and out-of-scope handling preserve truthfulness and independence without unanimity or automatic resets.
acceptance.AC3: Same-owner repairs and finite phase/approval/content gates remain explicit; static positive and negative checks protect the coordinator policy.
acceptance.AC4: Documentation, focused workflow tests and required lint/format/type/offline/evaluation/build/Compose checks pass; roles and prior history unchanged; independent review and ordinary content-bound delivery.

risks: Static validation cannot prove live coordinator behavior or authority authenticity
Arbitration might mask genuine defects or bypass finite gates unless explicitly bounded
escalation_triggers: Concrete contract ambiguity returns to separate architect within remaining authorized allowance
Failed final review or exhausted counts stops for explicit user decision; no renewal
Out-of-scope concerns deferred as separate work
